stories.title: Chester Zoo scientists help identify new wild cat species in Bolivia
stories.summary: Chester Zoo scientists have helped confirm the discovery of a new wild cat species in Bolivia, the first new feline to be formally described to science in a century. stories.title: Police warn drivers to check pay-at-pump card readers for fraud devices
stories.summary: North Wales Police has warned drivers to check pay-at-pump card readers at petrol stations after becoming aware of a fraud method that uses hidden devices to steal bank card details. stories.title: Flintshire and Wrexham MS to chair new Senedd hospice care group
stories.summary: Sam Rowlands MS, who represents Flintshire and Wrexham in the Senedd, has been named chair of a new cross-party group on palliative and hospice care. stories.title: police HGV cab catches drivers on their phones on the A55
stories.summary: North Wales Police stopped more than 30 vehicles on the A55, A483 and A494 earlier this month as part of Operation Tramline.
